local_cells.graph: Q3 = K4,4 minus a perfect matching

canonical_edge_label: edge between point-cover r and flag-cover (p,q) iff r lies on q and r!=p; equivalently the directed W33 edge p->r
theorem: The forty local 2^3 cover packets glue canonically into a connected 40+160 bipartite graph. Their 480 edges are exactly the directed W33 edges, grouped into forty edge-disjoint cube graphs indexed by W33 lines.
